title: Nice that you can microwave or freeze
text: Nice that you can microwave or freeze. These are nice because you can pack up to three different items in one container and have them well separated.  You put one item in the bottom and then you insert a two compartment tray above and add two more items.  The tray for other items is optional of course if you are only packing one item.  These are microwavable and freezer safe, so that's a nice plus.  They are a little more durable that some food containers, but don't seem strong or durable enough to be permanent, but are good for more than just one time use.
